raw_response:
The issuer exhibits severe financial distress, primarily due to an extremely low current ratio of 0.35, indicating critical liquidity issues and an inability to cover short-term obligations. Additionally, the high leverage is evident from a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 8.09 and a debt-to-assets ratio of 89%, compounded by negative working capital of -103,116M. While profitability is reasonable with an EBIT margin of 31.6%, it is insufficient to offset the liquidity and solvency risks, suggesting high vulnerability to default.

DECISION: CCC
